Method of Attack: Exploits vulnerabilities in IoT devices and Claymore mining rigs to hijack mining credentials and redirect mining rewards
Uses exploit code targeting ports 52869 (CVE-2014-8361), 37215 (CVE-2017-17215), and 3333 (Claymore mining software management interface vulnerability allowing unauthenticated access)
Impacted Systems: IoT devices running old firmware vulnerable to Realtek SDK and Huawei router exploits
Attack Vector: Scanning and exploiting open ports 52869, 37215, and 3333 to gain unauthorized access
Replacing mining configuration on compromised Claymore rigs to redirect mining rewards
Indicators of Compromise: Message left by attacker: 'Satori dev here, dont be alarmed about this bot it does not currently have any malicious packeting purposes move along. I can be contacted at curtain@riseup.net'
